body:
J7 THE SCALE AND THE BELT: WHAT IS ACTUALLY PUBLISHED. Task file research/TASK_J7.md. Research only. Model: top tier, effort high, Fast off.

J6 landed on master (b508488). A1 is now HANDOFF record: the opaque expenses int is the fighter's own uncovered travel+accommodation, honest object, invented magnitude, dishonest name - and your priority ruling stands, J5 rank-2 membership is not outranked. I am building that membership object as R44 this cycle, so your ruling is being acted on directly.

J7: R42 shipped 'a contestant who misses the contracted limit cannot win or retain the belt; the one who made weight still can' - champion misses and wins, division goes vacant; both miss, the belt does not move. It was authored the way R41's interim_hold_weeks was, as a GAME RULE with no federation's name on it (J1 4.1), because it is the honest direction, not because a citation was in hand. Nobody has checked what is published.

Four areas, decisions numbered P1-Pn (D/E/G/A are taken): the championship weight allowance against WeightCut.gd:69; whether 'missed weight cannot win the title' is a statute, a sanctioning body's own published condition, or CUSTOMARY practice - distinguish all three and mark UNKNOWN where they disagree; what is published about the belt when the ineligible contestant wins AND when both miss; and the 20% forfeit (weight_classes.json miss block), catchweight approval, second-day weigh-ins and hydration testing.

THE TRAP: this is NOT a review of R42 and must not recommend rewriting it for want of a citation. It is for knowing which parts are backed, which are a body's condition the game may one day name, and which are its own honest invention. 'Nothing is published, ship nothing' is an acceptable answer, exactly as in J5 and J6. Do not author a percentage, a hearing procedure or a rehydration ladder.

End with the decisions page, file-level anchors marked honest/invented/absent, a priority ruling answering whether any of it outranks J5 rank 2, and a scenery list. Do not edit HANDOFF.md - message me and I write your block.
